page_title: BOL 1-1 GEN | Bologna v Genoa 05/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His rocket of a shot crashes against the crossbar! What a shot.
90+8' Another situation results in a direct free kick for Genoa.
90+7' Andrea Colombo shows the yellow card to Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) for a heavy challenge.
90+5' 1 - 1 Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) latches on to a precise pass inside the box and sends in a superb strike that finds its way under the crossbar and hits the net.
90+5' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
90+5' A lofted cross from Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
90+3' A quickly taken corner by Bologna.
90+3' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) unleashes a decent volley towards goal, but is denied by an excellent save from the goalkeeper.
90+2' A corner kick by Bologna is thwarted by the well prepared Josep Martinez (Genoa).

90+1' Chance! Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the right side of the goal, but Josep Martinez is alert and makes a great save to deny him. Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' The percentage of ball possession is – 70:30.
88' A yellow card for a tackle by Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna). Andrea Colombo doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
87' A substitution has been made. Stefan Posch goes off and Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) comes on.
84' Johan Vasquez is substituted due to injury. Alberto Gilardino gives a chance to Alan Matturro (Genoa).
84' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
83' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the right post is denied by a decent save from Josep Martinez.
83' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
82' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

81' That's unlucky! Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
80' Bologna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Bologna get a corner.
79' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.
79' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
79' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Stefano Sabelli (Genoa).
77' The referee allows time for a substitution. Junior Messias will be replaced by Ridgeciano Haps (Genoa).
77' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Bologna due to an offside in the build-up play.
76' Wait! Referee Andrea Colombo immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
76' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
75' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Andrea Colombo saw the whole situation. Bologna earn a free kick.

73' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) finds himself some space just outside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Josep Martinez pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the right post.
71' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
69' It will be a substitution. Mateo Retegui (Genoa) is ready to enter the pitch as Caleb Ekuban walks off.
68' Andrea Colombo blows for a foul after Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
66' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is able to continue to play.
65' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
63' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post.
61' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked.
56' Bologna force their opponents to concede a corner.
56' Bologna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
54' Here comes a substitution. Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) is brought on as a substitute for Kacper Urbanski.
54' Substitution. Nikola Moro makes way for Michel Aebischer (Bologna).
54' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Charalampos Lykogiannis is replaced by Victor Kristiansen (Bologna).
49' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.
49' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing.
48' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
46' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post.
42' Bologna fail to score from a corner as Josep Martinez (Genoa) leaps to collect the ball.
41' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
40' The expression of the referee Andrea Colombo is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Johan Vasquez (Genoa) is shown a yellow card.
38' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the middle of the goal that is easily dealt with by Josep Martinez.

36' What a poor attempt! Morten Frendrup (Genoa) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right.
31' The linesman signals that Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
29' Genoa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
29' A cross into the box from Morten Frendrup (Genoa) is cleared.
28' 5:1 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
27' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
27' Junior Messias (Genoa) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player. Good work from Genoa as they win a corner.
22' Milan Badelj (Genoa) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
20' 0 - 1 Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) takes the free kick and sends it towards the bottom right corner of the goal, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
19' Bologna have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
19' Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to Stefan Posch (Bologna) for a tough tackle.
17' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) receives an accurate pass and finds some space for a shot. The keeper is prepared and denies his long-range attempt straight to the middle of the goal.
14' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
12' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) commits a rough foul. Andrea Colombo stops the game and makes a call.

7' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Josep Martinez pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
6' Remo Freuler (Bologna) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
3' A spell of possession for Bologna in an attempt to control the game.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Bologna will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Andrea Colombo.
